scripts.build: npm run build -w @task-pipeline/core && npm run build -w @task-pipeline/integrations && npm run build -w @task-pipeline/pi-package && npm run build -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run package:dir -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run package:mac -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run package:linux -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run dev --workspace @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:node && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @task-pipeline/core && npm run build -w @task-pipeline/integrations && npm run typecheck -w @task-pipeline/pi-package && npm run typecheck -w @task-pipeline/desktop
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run lint:css
